paite: Huan zawlneite tapate'n Elisha kiang ah, "En in, hiai mun na kiang a ka tenna uh kou a ding in akochik lua hi.
heading: Heitang Muh Nawnna

paite: K'on ngen uh. Jordan lui ah ka hohsuk ding ua, huai ah sing ka va la chiat ding ua, ka tenna ding uh huai ah ka va lam ding uh aw?" achi uhi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kuan ve ua,” achi hi.
Mi khat in, "Na sikhate kiang ah hoh sam in," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hoh sam leng akei dia," chi in adawng hi.
Huchi in akiang uah ahoh samta hi. Jordan lui atun un sing aphuk uhi.
Mi khat in aphuk san lai in, aheitang tui ah akia hi. Ama'n, "Maizen! Pu, mi a kikhel ei ve," chi in akikou hi.
Pathian mipa in, "Koi lai ah ahia akiak?" achi hi. Ama'n akiakna mun a-ensak hi. Huchi in singhiang khat asat a, huai ah apailut a, sik ahong kilam hi.
Ama'n, "Tawm aw le," achi a; huchi in asawk a, atawmta hi.
Siria kumpipa'n Israelte ahong dou in, huai mun ah giahphual ka sat ding, chi in asikhate thu akum hi.
heading: Siria Sepaihte Zoh Ahi Uh

paite: Pathian mipa'n Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Huchibang mun a hoh lou ding in pilvang in. Huai ah Siriate ahong suk ding uh," chi in mi asawl hi.
Israel kumpipa'n Pathian mipa'n ana hilhna mun mi ava enkhesak zel hi. Huai ah khatvei nihvei phet lou in, ana kihumbit zel hi.
Huchi in huai thu ah Siria kumpipa lungtang amangbanggawp hi. Asikhate asam a, akiang uah, "I lak ua mi akua pen ahia Israel kumpipa lam a pang? N'on hilh kei ding ua hia?" achi hi.
Asikhate lak a mi khat in, "Kuamah pang kei ve ung e, kumpipa, ka toupa aw. Israel gam a om zawlnei Elisha in na dantan sunggil a na gente Israel kumpipa ana hilh zel ahi zaw hi." achi hi.
Ama'n, "Koi a om ahia va simzon un, ka va mansak ding," achi hi, "Ngai in, Dothan ah a-om,” chi in ahilh uhi.
Huchi in sakolte, kangtalaite leh sepaih tampite huai ah asawl a, zan in ava hoh ua, khua a-umkimvel uhi.
Pathian mipa sikha zingkhang in athou a, ava pawtkhiakleh, ngai in, sepaihte'n sakol leh kangtalaite toh khua ana umsuakta uh. Sikha in akiang ah, "Maizen! Pu aw, bang i chihta dia le?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Lau ke'n; amau lam a pangte sang in ei lam a pangte atamzaw hi,” achi hi.

Huchi in Elisha athum a, "TOUPA, amuhtheihna ding in amit vaksak in," achi hi. TOUPA'N huai tangval mit avaksak a; huchi in amu samta a; ngai in, Elisha kimvel a mualte mei kangtalai leh sakol in adim vekta hi.
Amah lam a ahong paisuk uleh TOUPA kiang ah Elisha athum a, "Hiai mite mit tawsak in," achi hi. Huchi in Elisha thu bang in amit uh atawsakta hi.
Elisha in akiang uah, "Hiai lampi ahi kei, hiai leng khua ahi sam kei. Kei hon zui un, na mizonpa uh kiang ah ka hon pi ding,” achi hi. Huchi in Samaria ah apita hi.

Samaria khosung atun un hichi ahong hi a, Elisha in, "TOUPA, hiaite'n amuhtheihna ding un amit uh vaksak in," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N amit uh avaksak a, amuta ua; ngai in, Samaria khosung ah ana omta uhi.
Israel kumpipa'n amaute amuh in Elisha kiang ah, "Ka pa aw, ka that diam? Ka that diam?" achi hi.
Ama'n adawng a, "That ke'n, na namsau leh na thalpeu in na salmatte na that dia hia? Tanghou leh tui ama uah lui inla, ne in dawn uhenla, apu uh kiang ah paikik nawn uhen," achi hi.
Huchi in nek ding thupi mahmah abawlsak a; anek ua adawn khit un apaisak vek ua, apu uh kiang lam ah apai nawn uh. Huchi in Siria pawlte Israel gam ah ahong nawnta kei uhi.
Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad in asepaih tengteng akaikhawm a, Samaria khua ava um hi.
heading: Samaria Khua Um Bichilhna

paite: Samaria ah kial anasa mahmah a, ngai in, sabiltung lutang dangka sawmgiat a akhot uh leh begap kab mun li a khen mun khat dangka nga a lei ahih tan hial un, khua a-um bikbek hi.
Israel kumpipa kulh dawn a apai lai in numei khat in, "Aw kumpipa, ka toupa, hon huh in," chi in ana sam hi.
Ama'n, "TOUPA'N ahon panpih ngal keileh ke'n koi a pan in ahia ka hon panpih ding? Buhphual ahihkeileh grep sukna khuk a pan in maw?"
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Bang na chi a ahia awi?" achi nawn hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Hiai numei in ka kiang ah, tuni in na tapa i nek ding in hon thoh ve, zingchiang in ka tapa i ne na kei dia," achi hi.
Huchi in ka tapa ka huan ua, ka ne uh. Azing in ke'n akiang ah, "Na tapa i nek ding in hon thoh sam in, ka chi hi. Ama'n atapa aselgu maimah hi,” achi hi.
Kumpipa'n numei thugen azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuan abotkek a; kulh dawn a apai lai ahi a; mipite'n a-et uleh, ngai in, asa tung ah sai-ip puan ana silh nilouh hi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Tuni a Shaphat tapa Elisha in alutang apuak lai peuhmah leh Pathian in alohloh in hon loh mai hen, huai sang a leng thupizaw in," achi hi.

Elisha a-inn ah atu a, upate leng akiang ah atu sam uh. Kumpipa'n akiang ah mi khat asawl a, himahleh amisawl akiang atun ma in upate kiang ah, "Hiai tualthatpa tapa in ka lu la ding in mi ahon sawl, chih na thei na uhia? Pau kei dih ua, amisawl ahong tun chiang in, kong na khak unla, kongkhak in na dal bikbek un. Anung ah apu kalsuan ging akiza kei maw?" achi hi.
Huchi a amau ahoupih san lai in, ngai in, amisawl ahong tungsuk hi. Ngai in, kumpipa'n, "Hiai thil hoih lou TOUPA hon sawl ahi; bang ding in TOUPA ka hungaih lailai dia? chi ahi," achi hi.
